decisions.quote: committee reorganization: we have a new member, planning board member, matthew allison. tabled reorganization.

decisions.decision: Tom Lam to get the presentation draft to the committee before the next week's meeting, and Greg Roy to prepare an outline for committee discussion at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated he will have an outline that we can discuss as a committee at our next meeting.

decisions.decision: The town manager will let the town moderator know that architects may present the article, as she typically allows.
decisions.quote: the town manager stated the town manager would typically allow that and that she would let him know that is the case.

decisions.decision: Greg Roy to look into having someone come to address the commercial kitchen question.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated he can look into having someone come.

decisions.decision: A handout of the schematic design is to be given to the town clerk for distribution as people check in.
decisions.quote: greg roy agreed there should be a handout and it needs to be given to the town clerk as people check in.

decisions.decision: Next meeting, Monday November 9, to focus on Town Meeting presentation preparation.
decisions.quote: next meeting on monday the 9th we will focus on this.

decisions.decision: Schematic design to be put on the town website and shared on Facebook; Brian Lehtinen to share a list of community Facebook pages.
decisions.quote: brian lehtinen stated he could share a list with the community.

decisions.decision: Parking to be fine-tuned during the design development stage.
decisions.quote: ed said we will fine tune the parking and we will still be looking at it.
